correctness.rationale: The Walsh expansion is exact: all nonempty proper moments vanish, leaving only \(\theta=\mathbb E\prod_i\varepsilon_i\). Thus the event probability is \(2^{-n}(N_n+\theta A_n)\). Reflection/ballot counting gives \(N_n=\binom{n-1}{\lfloor(n-1)/2\rfloor}\). The signed ballot sum \(A_n=\sum_d(-1)^d[\binom{n-1}{d}-\binom{n-1}{d-1}]\) is zero for odd \(n\ge3\) and \((-1)^{n/2-1}C_{n/2-1}\) for even \(n\), by the alternating partial-binomial identity. Substitution yields the stated formula.
